testcase.name: Scenario: Enable a panel while the ribbon is minimized: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:327:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Enable a panel while the ribbon is minimized ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active ✔ And the Parameters panel is hidden ✔ When the user right-clicks the 3D Model tab ✔ And the user opens Show Panels ✔ And the user selects the unchecked Parameters entry ✔ Then the menus close and the ribbon remains minimized to tabs ✔ When the user clicks the 3D Model tab once ✔ Then the temporary command area opens ✔ And it contains the Parameters panel ✔ When the user double-clicks the 3D Model tab ✔ Then the full ribbon is restored ✔ And the Parameters panel is visible
